men.summary: At 2-1 after an 89-82 loss at Kansas State on Nov 10, the Bluejays are coming off a road setback following home wins over Kansas City (76-61) and Le Moyne (83-55), and they have yet to play a Quadrant 1 game or a Big East contest. With a NET ranking of 83 and an RPI of 182, their at-large case is still undeveloped, so they will need to build a strong résumé in Big East play to move into NCAA Tournament contention.

women.summary: At 2-1 with both wins on the road, including a 73-71 Quad 1 win at South Dakota State and a 66-60 win at North Dakota State, the Bluejays sit at NET 91 and RPI 79 but dropped their latest game 54-49 to South Dakota on a neutral court. With Big East play still ahead (0-0), they're on the at-large bubble's outer edge, and they'll need a strong conference record and more quality wins to climb into NCAA contention, with a WBIT bid the more realistic fallback.
